description: The Vehicle Energy Dataset is published by Geunseob Oh, David LeBlanc and Huei Peng at the University of Michigan for vehicle energy and behaviour research. It contains GPS trajectories and onboard diagnostic measurements from 383 personal cars in Ann Arbor between November 2017 and November 2018, totalling about 374,000 miles. The fleet includes gasoline, hybrid and plug-in/electric vehicles. Dynamic CSV files record time-stamped speed, fuel and power variables; XLSX files describe vehicle characteristics. The repository publishes the dataset under Apache-2.0 at no charge. A limitation is that only three vehicles are pure EVs, all 2013 Nissan Leafs, and one city and year do not represent every fleet or climate. VED can calibrate vehicle-consumption, route-choice and traffic simulations. SUMO (model-sumo) is a related simulation tool. Only the data description and repository metadata were inspected; no driving records or archives were downloaded.
name: Vehicle Energy Dataset (VED)
